data.why: the repo ships a self-contained sample scRNA/ST pair under sample_dataset/ with pairs.csv linking them; the GUI takes server-side file paths (text fields, not uploads), so the browser just types the repo-relative paths of files already present at runtime.

goals: load a paired scRNA reference and spatial transcriptomics dataset and confirm they pass validation (raw counts, matching uppercase gene symbols, spatial coordinates present)
run the Leiden over-clustering and agglomeration sweep across a range of cell-state counts K with a chosen spot-to-state mapper
use the Overview page to compare starting points and mappers at their best-scoring K
use Explore to inspect reconstruction quality, spatial coherence and transcriptional coherence for a chosen K and decide the most reliable cell-state granularity
use Compare to weigh two mapping methods against each other on the same starting point
inspect the Single-cell reference page to relate chosen cell states back to the original scRNA annotations

review.summary: The tree describes SpatialAIM's purpose accurately: sweep cell-state granularity K and pick the level that maps reliably onto spatial data. The screens I sampled mostly match the tree, apart from two misplaced citations (035 for progress, 016 for the validation dialog). It needs small additions (criteria comparison, marker genes, segmentation and shape features, incremental runs), the two citation corrections and a valid re-replay, because the current check.json failed during setup and confirms nothing.
